annotations.text:
1 · ENTRY
Glyph is reached from the Sampler's header, beside Patterns.
It consumes the stems the separator just produced.

2 · CHOOSE A SONG
Local MP3 and FLAC only — the two formats the conversion
service is specified for. Each row states its chart status:
tempo and tiers when ready, 'No chart' when not.

3 · GENERATE
Decode, separate the drums, read the rhythm off the
transients, write five difficulties to an SSC. Offline, and
it reports which backend actually ran.

4 · PICK A TIER
Defaults to the middle of what exists, not the hardest.
Play and Training Ground are peers — practice is not an
advanced option hidden behind a first run.

5 · PLAY
Four lanes, receptors above the notes, explosions above
those. The scroll mode sits in the HUD because it is the
first thing checked when a chart reads wrong.

6 · RESULTS
The graph is the point: the weakest section is one tap
from becoming a practice loop, with the chart still loaded.

PAUSE — scroll and speed
XMod / CMod / MMod. Scroll changes only the reading;
speed changes the music. They are constantly confused,
so they are separate controls with separate labels.

TRAINING GROUND — the loop back
Segment handles on the waveform, live early/late and
spread, ghost of the last run, and gauntlets that find the
passage in this chart rather than a synthetic one.
